observations: Royal blue ground. Rows of elongated, nested tonal diamonds form pointed fans across the body and sleeves, approximately four full diamonds across the torso. Navy crew collar with thin white inner piping; navy cuffs with thin white edge. No white side panels are visible in this front product photo.
omitted: Club emblems, sponsors, manufacturer logo symbols, lettering, badges and tiny textile weave. Observed garment trim is retained.

visual_review.notes: Compared official flat front: elongated nested fan diamonds, about four across torso; navy/white crew collar and cuffs. Removed unsupported white side panels from earlier draft. No claim of exact textile-photo reproduction or official HEX values.

revision_reason: Refine nested fan/diamond spacing and remove unsupported white side panels after reinspection of full front.
